scope: Exploratory follow-up after original test disclosure; original 800 train rows only
selection: Separate TPE search for each cap; inner OOF cost only. No outer labels used in selection.
failure: No feasible inner candidate means missing outer predictions; never relax a cap or substitute an infeasible candidate.
interpretation: Report every prespecified variant. Outer folds measure split variation, not 5 independent sampler seeds. Do not select a deployment model from these outer scores.
